title: At the estate agent
instructions: Bir çift emlakçıda iki daireyi konuşuyor. Hangi özelliğin hangi daireye ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: So, I have two flats that might be good for you. The first one is on Queen Street.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Nine hundred pounds a month. It has two bedrooms and a big kitchen, but it's on the fourth floor and there's no lift.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hmm, we have a baby, so stairs are a problem. What about the other one?

script.speaker: a
script.text: The second flat is on Park Road. It's on the ground floor and has a small garden. It's a bit smaller, with one bedroom and a study.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Eight hundred and fifty. It's also closer to the train station.

script.speaker: b
script.text: That sounds better for us. Can we see it this week?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, how about Thursday at six?

script.speaker: b
script.text: My wife finishes work at six thirty. Is seven OK?
